title: NexusDaemonMomentInspectResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/inspector/moment (V1.151 P0 DF-76). Mirrors the enriched inspector packet emitted by nexus-moment-context-assembly::inspector::build_inspector_packet 1:1: spoke `modules` (placement + activation_trace), plus four additive product-local sections — `slot_map`, `budget`, `moment_directive` (status/metadata only; the directive body is NEVER on the wire — AC-I3) and `hygiene` (per-entry regex-transform trace, DF-79; optional on the wire — absent when no carrier-bearing entries). Three sections are always present with nullable/empty values; `hygiene` is additive-optional. Root `additionalProperties: false` per the H1 locked pattern: the schema is the SSOT — product-local sections grow by extending schema + codegen together, and the handler's packet round-trip fails loudly (500) on unknown root sections instead of silently dropping them.

reason.description: Why the entry was matched or not.

accepted.description: Whether the entry ended up in the matched placement.

slot_map.description: entry_id → slot id (world.before | default | world.after | kb.outlet.<name> | style.post_history | moment.directive), captured post stage-gate at assembly time.

slot.description: The named slot the entry landed in.

primary_tokens_est.description: Estimated primary-match tokens. Zero when no activation ran.

hop_tokens_est.description: Estimated relation-hop tokens. Zero when no activation ran.

cap.description: Activation budget cap; null when no activation ran.

remaining.description: Remaining budget after activation; null when no activation ran.

moment_directive.description: Status/metadata only — the directive body is excluded by construction (AC-I3); "none" + nulls when no directive injected.

scope.description: Directive scope kind: work | world. Null when no directive injected.

scope_id.description: Work id (scope=work) or world id (scope=world). Null when no directive injected.

insert_depth.description: Placement within the directive region: head | mid | tail. Null when no directive injected.

ttl_kind.description: TTL kind: generations | chapters. Null when no directive injected.

ttl_remaining.description: Remaining TTL count after this assembly's decrement. Null when no directive injected.

clear_on_scene_change.description: Clear when the focused moment anchor changes between assembles. False when no directive injected.

status.description: Open string. Core vocabulary (documented, not enforced): none (no directive injected), active (directive injected this assembly).

hygiene.description: Per-entry regex-hygiene transform trace (DF-79), one row per carrier-bearing entry; absent when no entry carried `body.attributes.hygiene`. Each row reports the transform outcome for that entry.

applied.description: Performed replacements (total across all applied transforms).

notes.description: Diagnostics ("invalid regex" / truncation / malformed carrier); no-match is silent.
